en: A vintage black‑and‑white street scene showing a wide, tree‑lined avenue with early 20th‑century houses on both sides. Several children in dresses and coats stand and play in the street, while a horse‑drawn cart is visible further down the road. Gas-style street lamps line the sidewalks. At the bottom of the image, printed captions identify the city and street, with additional small publisher text and a large handwritten signature across the lower margin.
